description: Fixture maker for late: from ch4, idle with skips and hires, claim every chapter 4-6 quest (packs, free shop loot, bonus XP badges), level up henchmen and gear from the henchman popup, farm the Desert Ruin (Sand Dunes, Ruin Entrance, Ancient Library: manual runs finished by skips until their henchmen get cards), unlock and farm the Forest Ruin, close chapters 4, 5 and 6, assign the Elf Mercenary (Sylaei) as second hero, then in chapter 7 reassign her, reopen the farm's three levels, accept the skeleton bone quest and claim free loot.
